_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Tunnel Manager are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `vrooli scenario generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

exposure.title: Exposure

overview.readinessFallback: Tunnel Manager can run locally until remote credentials are available.
overview.circuitOpenWarning: Circuit breaker is open — automatic recovery is paused.
overview.modeLocal: Mode: local — ingress is managed from the local cloudflared config.
overview.modeLocalKeysConfigured: Mode: local — Cloudflare keys configured but not in use.
overview.driftUnavailable: Remote drift evidence is unavailable until Cloudflare credentials are available. Retry or open setup.
overview.accessUnavailable: Public Access policy evidence is unavailable. The /public boundary cannot be verified until Access status loads.
overview.classificationUnavailable: Route reachability evidence is unavailable. Retry diagnostics before treating routes as healthy.
overview.constellationUnavailable: Live exposure topology is unavailable. Retry the affected data sources before acting.
overview.mobileRoutesEmpty: No live routes are available yet.
overview.staleFinding: Exposure data is older than 5 minutes. Refresh before acting.

config.setupDescription: Choose local or remote ingress management, verify Cloudflare credential readiness, and reconcile ingress from the manifest.
config.credentialsDescription: Save remote-mode credentials through the Vrooli credential authority. The API token is write-only and is not shown after saving.
config.credentialPolicyBody: Settings writes credentials through the Vrooli credential authority. Environment variables are not accepted as a credential source.
config.cloudflareTokenHelp: Use a least-privilege Cloudflare API token that can read and update the managed tunnel configuration.
config.apiTokenHelp: The token secret is sent only with the save request, then cleared from this form. It is never returned by the API.
config.nextActionMissing: Enter the missing fields, save credentials, then preview sync before switching to remote mode.
config.nextActionUnavailable: Remote mode is unavailable until the complete Cloudflare credential set is present.
config.nextActionReady: Remote credentials are ready. Preview sync, switch to remote mode, then apply sync.
config.nextActionRemote: Remote mode is active. Preview sync before applying manifest changes to Cloudflare.
config.credentialReadOnlyWarning: One or more credential fields are read-only in this interface. Use the canonical operator credential surface to update them.
config.credentialSaved: Credentials saved. Token value is hidden.
config.verificationDescription: Checks the current credential against the account, tunnel, DNS, and Access surfaces. Results never include the token.
config.verificationUnavailable: Live verification is unavailable until remote credentials are present.
config.syncChanged: Sync changed {{added}} added and {{removed}} removed hostnames.
config.switchModeNote: Switching to remote mode no longer auto-pushes ingress. Use Reconcile to apply manifest routes additively, then review drift for anything live that the manifest does not own.
config.publicExposureBody: When on, Tunnel Manager creates a narrow Cloudflare Access bypass for the /public path of each exposed host, so branding and PWA assets are fetchable without a login. Everything outside /public stays gated. Default is off; per-route overrides can force it on or off.

exposure.heading: Exposed scenarios
exposure.filteredEmpty: No exposures match the current filters.
exposure.searchPlaceholder: Filter by scenario, subdomain, or URL
exposure.chooseKnownRoute: Choose a known route from the manifest before continuing.
exposure.routeCatalogError: Known routes could not be loaded. Retry before exposing a scenario.
exposure.revokeConfirmDescription: This immediately disables the leased route and removes its active exposure. You can expose it again later.
exposure.copyError: The URL could not be copied. Copy it manually from the route details.
exposure.reviewDescription: Confirm the route, access boundary, and lease before making this scenario public.
exposure.authProtected: Protected outside /public; assets may be anonymous
exposure.policyAcknowledgement: I understand the primary application remains protected; only the explicitly described /public/* asset boundary may be anonymous.
exposure.verificationHint: The API confirms the lease and route. Probe verification runs separately and is never inferred from configuration alone.
exposure.provisioningStageRequest: Creating the lease and reconciling tunnel ingress
exposure.provisioningStageVerification: Verification will run separately after the mutation returns
exposure.provisioningRemediationPrecondition: The target is not eligible yet. Review its port, lifecycle, or readiness findings, then retry.
exposure.provisioningRemediationPermission: The request reached an authorization boundary. Review credential or policy scope before retrying.
exposure.provisioningRemediationUnavailable: The service did not respond. Confirm the scenario is healthy and retry when the dependency is available.
exposure.provisioningRemediationUnknown: Review the classified error, correct the reported condition, and retry. Public reachability is not inferred from this failure.
exposure.expiredDescription: These routes are no longer public. Review the scenario and choose a new lease before exposing again.

recovery.summaryHealthy: Recovery is monitoring the tunnel. No restart is queued.
recovery.summaryFailure: {{count}} consecutive failure(s) detected. Recovery will wait for policy thresholds before acting.
recovery.summaryCircuitOpen: The circuit breaker is open. Automatic recovery is paused until the retry window or a forced operator override.
recovery.summaryRecovering: A recovery attempt is in progress. Avoid starting another restart until the current attempt settles.
recovery.nextActionHealthy: Keep monitoring. Run manual recovery only after confirming tunnel reachability is degraded.
recovery.nextActionFailure: Inspect probe and tunnel metrics before forcing a restart.
recovery.nextActionCircuitOpen: Wait for the retry window or use force only when operator evidence confirms recovery is required.
recovery.nextActionRecovering: Refresh the state and timeline after the attempt completes.
recovery.policyNote: Automatic recovery follows server policy and the circuit breaker. Manual recovery restarts cloudflared and re-pushes ingress.
recovery.forceWarning: Force bypasses the breaker/backoff window and should be reserved for confirmed outages.
recovery.recoverConfirmBody: This restarts cloudflared and re-pushes ingress. Tunnel Manager is the single restart owner, so this is safe — but it briefly interrupts the tunnel.

metrics.heading: Tunnel metrics
metrics.empty: No metrics samples have been scraped yet.
metrics.scrapeError: Metrics scrape failed. Retry the collection.
metrics.classificationScope: Current diagnostics classify healthy, tunnel-down, scenario-down, and config-drift from internal/external probe pairs. DNS failure and Cloudflare outage remain deferred until richer signals exist.

remediation.mismatch: Update the manifest route or the scenario service.json fixed UI port, then reconcile exposure.
remediation.missingScenario: Restore or remove the manifest route before the next ingress sync.
remediation.missingPort: Declare one fixed UI port in the scenario service.json before exposing it.
remediation.unknown: Inspect the scenario service manifest and rerun the audit.

drift.heading: Ingress drift
drift.empty: No ingress hostnames are live yet.
drift.modeHint: Drift compares the live tunnel ingress against the manifest and the ownership ledger. When Cloudflare credentials are configured, the live ingress is read from the Cloudflare API (the real tunnel); otherwise it is read from the local cloudflared config.
drift.pruneConfirmBody: This removes {{hostname}} from live ingress and the ownership ledger. If a route still desires it, the next sync re-adds it.

routes.externalDescription: Routes that point at an arbitrary local service target rather than a known scenario's UI port.
routes.addError: Could not add the route. Please retry.
routes.deleteError: Could not delete the route. Please retry.

publicExposure.label: Public exposure
publicExposure.rowLabel: Change public exposure for this route
publicExposure.help: Public exposure controls the /public Access bypass for this route. Inherit follows the global switch; enabled forces the bypass on; disabled forces it off.
publicExposure.error: Could not update public exposure. Please retry.

access.heading: Public Access bypass
access.description: The /public Access-bypass read model: the global switch, Cloudflare Access client status, per-host decisions, and the dry-run plan.
access.note: This is a read-only status view. It reports what a reconcile would do and never changes Cloudflare Access by itself.
access.empty: No exposed hosts to report Access status for yet.
